sections.title: Google Analytics 4
paragraphs: We use Google Analytics 4 (GA4) to understand how visitors use this website and to improve it. The service is provided by Google. Our measurement ID is G-GLZ0H84MBV.

If you accept analytics, GA4 can process page views, page addresses, referrer information, browser and device information, interaction data, and pseudonymous identifiers stored in first-party cookies. Google says that Google Analytics does not log or store raw IP addresses; it uses IP information to provide the service and derive general location information. Google explains the data collected by Analytics.

sections.title: Consent and choice
paragraphs: Analytics is optional. The Google tag is not loaded and no analytics data is sent before you accept. Your choice is stored in your browser's local storage so the site can remember it; this preference stays on your device and is not sent to Google.

You can reject analytics or withdraw a previous choice at any time using the “Privacy settings” control at the bottom left of the site. If you withdraw consent, the site tells Google to stop analytics storage and does not send further page-view events. You can also clear this site's stored data in your browser.

sections.title: Google, transfers, and retention
paragraphs: When you accept analytics, data is transmitted to Google. Google may process data on servers outside Switzerland. Information about Google's privacy practices and international data transfers is available in Google's Privacy Policy and Google's information about data transfers.
Google Analytics user-level and event-level data is retained according to the retention setting configured for this GA4 property. See Google's data-retention documentation.

sections.title: Questions
paragraphs: For questions about this website's use of Google Analytics or to make a privacy request, contact us at yoshi-moshi@yoshi-moshi.com.
